title: Test first: pick the cheapest passing model per pilot from the ledger
goal: Pure selector over ledger results: input pilot to pack mapping, candidates with cost order, pass threshold; output choice plus evidence reference
acceptance: Failing tests first: cheapest passing wins; none passes leads to no choice and a stated reason (no silent cloud); a stale or missing ledger entry is not a pass
Cost order is local (free) then Haiku, Sonnet, Opus by the price snapshots (src/model-usage.ts), never guessed from the model name
src/ stays free of framework imports
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
